reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her direct message: Dock 38, which she told me on Oct 14 is the dock she uses for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from now on.

I got the answer from her own direct-message history with me, not from gbrain. When I tried to read back the private note I saved yesterday, gbrain refused and read nothing. Its error says this brain serves several people, and my connection's token isn't tied to any of them. So for now gbrain won't return private notes saved for a member. Someone on the brain host would need to tie the token to the people it acts for; gbrain suggests running `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>` there. That's an admin decision, so I haven't changed anything.
